answer: Most convincing: on-ledger slashing of verifiers. Each verifier posts a stake-bond in a vault contract before countersigning; identity weight scales with bonded stake, so fake accounts gain nothing without real capital. If verifiers countersign an invalid transaction, an on-chain fraud proof burns the whole bond, priced above any epoch reward. An attacker pushing zephyr-speed sybil clones through an inlet of fake endpoints pays full collateral per identity while slash risk compounds per bad signature, making forgery unprofitable.
